title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: The DataFrame 'players' contains columns for 'team', 'position', $$'games_{played'}$$, and $$'points_{per,game'}$$. Each row represents a player with their respective data. Consider how these columns are used to calculate the 'total' column.

title: Calculating Total Points
text: The 'total' column is calculated by multiplying $$'games_{played'}$$ by $$'points_{per,game'}$$. This gives the total fantasy points a player scored in the season. Think about how this calculation is applied to each player.

title: Grouping by Team
text: The code groups the players by 'team' and calculates the mean of the 'total' points for each team. This results in a new DataFrame 'output' with the average total points per team.

title: Visualizing the Data
text: What type of plot is used to visualize the relationship between 'team' and 'total' in the 'output' DataFrame?
